facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's 2019 technology plan states that the Government adopted the Politica da Sociedade de Informacao (PSI), the Plano Estrategico para a Sociedade de Informacao (PESI) and the Plano Operacional (POSI) in 2018; the document does not describe their sector scope.
facts.system: Politica da Sociedade de Informacao (PSI) / PESI / POSI

facts.fact: The same document states that the Government adopted the Politica de Informatica in 2000 and approved the strategy for its implementation in 2002; it describes no scope and does not say whether either remains in force.

note: The document is the education ministry's own ICT plan (institution-plan); the only sector-class facts are its passing mentions of the 2000 and 2018 national ICT instruments.
